# TPC-DS-OBT Q35

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT bill_addr_ca_state, bill_cdemo_cd_gender, bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status, bill_cdemo_cd_dep_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt1, SUM(bill_cdemo_cd_dep_count) AS aggone1, SUM(bill_cdemo_cd_dep_count) AS aggtwo1, SUM(bill_cdemo_cd_dep_count) AS aggthree1, bill_cdemo_cd_dep_employed_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt2, SUM(bill_cdemo_cd_dep_employed_count) AS aggone2, SUM(bill_cdemo_cd_dep_employed_count) AS aggtwo2, SUM(bill_cdemo_cd_dep_employed_count) AS aggthree2, bill_cdemo_cd_dep_college_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt3, SUM(bill_cdemo_cd_dep_college_count) AS aggone3, SUM(bill_cdemo_cd_dep_college_count) AS aggtwo3, SUM(bill_cdemo_cd_dep_college_count) AS aggthree3 FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (ship_customer_c_current_addr_sk = bill_addr_ca_address_sk AND bill_cdemo_cd_demo_sk = ship_customer_c_current_cdemo_sk AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.ship_customer_c_customer_sk = obt.ship_customer_sk AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1999 AND obt.sold_date_d_qoy < 4) AND channel = 'store') AND (EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.ship_customer_c_customer_sk = obt.bill_customer_sk AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1999 AND obt.sold_date_d_qoy < 4) AND channel = 'web') OR EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.ship_customer_c_customer_sk = obt.ship_customer_sk AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1999 AND obt.sold_date_d_qoy < 4) AND channel = 'catalog'))) AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store', 'web') GROUP BY bill_addr_ca_state, bill_cdemo_cd_gender, bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status, bill_cdemo_cd_dep_count, bill_cdemo_cd_dep_employed_count, bill_cdemo_cd_dep_college_count ORDER BY bill_addr_ca_state, bill_cdemo_cd_gender, bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status, bill_cdemo_cd_dep_count, bill_cdemo_cd_dep_employed_count, bill_cdemo_cd_dep_college_count LIMIT 100
```
